synopsis: Chae-Na, who plays the unpopular Clover in [Magical Lucky Stars], the group that protects Madeleine Village. It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan. "I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!" She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is...
